meals.title: Sheet Pan Lemon Herb Chicken
meals.description: Weeknight chicken thighs and potatoes roasted on one pan.
instructions: Toss the potatoes with half the oil and salt; roast 15 minutes.
Mix the remaining oil, lemon, garlic and oregano; coat the chicken.
Add the chicken to the pan and roast 25 minutes more, until cooked through.

meals.name: Slow Cooker Black Bean Soup
meals.summary: Set it in the morning, top it at dinner.
ingredients: ½ cup sour cream, for serving
meals.steps:
1. Add everything except the sour cream to the slow cooker.
2. Cook on low for 6 hours.
3. Blend about half the soup, stir, and serve topped with sour cream.

directions.text: Stir everything but the berries together in a jar.
